findings.rationale: The described flaw requires systemd-gpt-auto-generator discovering attacker-injected GPT partitions during confidential guest boot. This application image removes that unused generator at both merged-usr paths and requires fresh absence evidence. Its entry point is the unprivileged application boundary, not a VM boot/init system; it has no mount program or mounting authority. Shared library packages remain scanned and are not declared patched. This container-specific assessment makes no assurance about the hosting hypervisor or TEE confidentiality.
